question.text: Consider a circular coil of wire carrying constant current <math><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi></math> forming a magnetic dipole. The magnetic flux through an infinite plane that contains the circular coil and excluding the circular coil area is given by <math><msub><mrow><mi>ϕ</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></math> The magnetic flux through the area of the circular coil area is given by <math><msub><mrow><mi>ϕ</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></math> . Which of the following option is correct?

solution.text:
As magnetic field lines always form a closed loop, hence every magnetic field line creating magnetic flux in the inner region must be passing through the outer region. Since flux in two regions are in opposite direction.
∴ϕi=-ϕ0
